title: smtp::config: .to_string() on string literals; should be .to_owned()
description: 7eee338 fixed default_username_claim() to use .to_owned() instead of .to_string() on a string literal. smtp/src/config.rs has 6 similar occurrences (default_db_path, default_sieve_admin_bind, default_nntp_addr, default_queue_dir, default_smtp_relay_queue_dir, default_hostname, default_log_level). The commit touched one instance in auth but left identical patterns in smtp untouched. .to_string() on a &str goes through the Display trait; .to_owned() is direct. The fix was correct but incomplete.
